Uncurser bundles unmodified third-party libraries. Their individual licenses
and package versions are included in this directory.

PySide6-Essentials and Shiboken6 declare LGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-2.0-only OR
GPL-3.0-only in their package metadata. Qt/PySide dynamic libraries and these
license texts are bundled in the executable and extracted to a temporary
directory at launch. LGPL-3.0 and its accompanying GPL-3.0 text are included.
These libraries are used under the LGPL option.
Do not remove the library license notices when redistributing the app.

Qt for Python source and project:
https://code.qt.io/pyside/pyside-setup
https://www.qt.io/qt-for-python

Qt source:
https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/

Python source and project:
https://www.python.org/downloads/source/

The application does not restrict modification or replacement of the LGPL
libraries, or reverse engineering for debugging modifications to them.

The optional bed screw adjustment helper includes modified Klipper
screws_tilt_adjust.py by Rui Caridade and Matthew Lloyd, under GPLv3.
Its source, copyright notices, and configuration are bundled as plain-text
assets with the app. The GPL-3.0 license text is included in this directory.

The Fluidd screw-dialog reference fragment and popup-local grid edits are
derived from Fluidd (GPLv3): https://github.com/fluidd-core/fluidd
The modification changes screw-result presentation and is supplied as
plain-text source in app/assets/screws-grid-edits.json.

The optional Fix Adaptive PA mod includes modified pressure-advance code
from Klipper, copyright Kevin O'Connor, under GPLv3:
https://github.com/Klipper3d/klipper
The corresponding source and build instructions are in native/pa and
tools/build_pa.py in the Uncurser source repository. The GPL-3.0 license
text is included in this directory.
